LanguageData.PhobosRadioCall_MenuCall: Call {FACTION} at {SETTLEMENT} on the radio (a {LINE} line)
LanguageData.PhobosRadioCall_MenuNone: No faction in radio reach to call
LanguageData.PhobosRadioCall_LostTouch: {PAWN} could not raise {FACTION}: they are out of radio reach now.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioCall_Greeting: {SETTLEMENT} of {FACTION} answers on the radio. The line is {LINE}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioCall_MarginalWarning: It is a poor line: a request may be misheard (about {CHANCE} of the time), the goodwill spent all the same.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioCall_CleanLine: It is a clean line: requests cost a little less than over the comms console.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioCall_Trader: Request a trader caravan from here (cost: {GOODWILL} goodwill; about {TIME} on the way)
LanguageData.PhobosRadioCall_AidTooFar: {FACTION} cannot get anyone to you in time
LanguageData.PhobosRadioCall_CheckIn: Check in and pass the time of day (+{GOODWILL} goodwill)
LanguageData.PhobosRadioCall_CheckInFriends: you are already the best of friends with {FACTION}
LanguageData.PhobosRadioCall_TraderSent: {FACTION} will send a caravan from {SETTLEMENT}. It should arrive in about {TIME}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioCall_Misheard: The line breaks up. {FACTION} heard only part of it and nothing will come of it; the goodwill is spent all the same.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioCall_AmbushLost: The trader caravan {FACTION} sent was ambushed on its way by {AMBUSHERS}, who had heard it asked for on the radio. It will not come, and the goodwill is spent.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioCall_AmbushHurt: The trader caravan {FACTION} sent was ambushed on its way by {AMBUSHERS}, who had heard it asked for on the radio. They fought their way through and have arrived, hurt.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioNews_RaidWarning: {FACTION} calls from {SETTLEMENT}: raiders are heading for {COLONY}. They should arrive in about {TIME}. Get ready.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingAlliesWarnOfRaids: Allies warn of raids by radio
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingAlliesWarnOfRaidsDesc: When raiders head for your colony and an ally's settlement is in reach of your radio stations, the ally calls to warn you, and the raid arrives a few hours later.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingListenersAmbushTrader: Hostile listeners can ambush a trader you ask for
A hostile settlement in reach of your radio stations may hear you ask for a trader caravan by radio and ambush it on its way: it arrives hurt, or not at all, with the goodwill spent.
